item.title: Binance Reports AI Risk Systems Prevented $4.64B in Potential Losses in H1 2026
item.summary: Binance disclosed via its official X account on August 6, 2026, that its AI-driven risk systems helped protect over 7.7 million users and prevented an estimated US$4.64 billion in potential losses during H1 2026; the figures are self-reported and have not been independently verified.
